mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is clear near Verona Area High School. Also, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:03 PM, passing from near the high school in the northwest toward Fitchburg in the east, climbing to halfway up the sky.

Candidates for the 2027 Spring Election can now pick up information packets at the City Clerk office. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and residents can pay online or use the drop box at the City Center.
There is a busy schedule starting today with The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, catch more live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On November 2, officers were called to a residence on West End Circle for a domestic disturbance, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Stop by for some delicious Mint Cookie, which is today's flavor. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
